original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can scripts/shared_point_circuit.py:SharedPointCircuit.verify_frames (and its support_in / contained helpers) keep identical nesting receipts on the historical h=46 circuit after replacing the thrashing lru_cache(maxsize=16384) with a per-instance dense table and local hot-path closures, without touching SharedPointCircuit.__init__, verify digests, or ExclusionCircuit.compile?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after merged #1994 (verify digests) and open #2054 (__init__ merge construction) left verify_frames / support_in as the residual hot path in bit-compression frame checks. Profiling on SharedPointCircuit(46).verify_frames with a precompiled program showed contained/support_in dominating, with CacheInfo misses far above the 16384 LRU cap.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: audit_bit_compression calls SharedPointCircuit.verify_frames on full-size circuits. Faster identical nesting does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving SharedPointCircuit.verify_frames / support_in change with frozen baseline, identical frame receipts on the historical h=46 circuit, registered replay and a measured before/after median at or above the ~1.5× tooling bar. Do not reopen #1994 digests, #2054 __init__, ExclusionCircuit.compile, or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_SHARED_POINT_FRAME_CONTAINS via research/shared-point-frame-contains/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_SHARED_POINT_FRAME_CONTAINS_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; bit-compression certificate does not pin scripts/shared_point_circuit.py in source_sha256. Folded into open CrocSwap #2054 with SharedPointCircuit.__init__ (same production file).
author: Wentao Li
